```{r}
# STEP 1: Explore Urban LiDAR Data Options

cat("URBAN LiDAR DATA EXPLORATION\n")
cat("===============================\n\n")

# I am loading the lidR package to work with LiDAR data
library(lidR)

# I am checking what sample data files are available in the lidR package
sample_files <- system.file("extdata", package = "lidR")
cat("Available lidR samples:\n")

# I am searching for LAS and LAZ files in the sample directory
las_files <- list.files(sample_files, pattern = "\\.(las|laz)$", full.names = FALSE)

# I am listing all the LiDAR files I found
for(i in 1:length(las_files)) {
  cat("  ", i, ":", las_files[i], "\n")
}

cat("\nChecking other potential sources...\n")

# I am examining each sample file to determine if it contains urban data
if(length(las_files) > 0) {
  cat("\nLet me examine each sample for urban potential:\n")
  for(file in las_files) {
    file_path <- system.file("extdata", file, package = "lidR")
    if(file.exists(file_path)) {
      # I am reading each LAS file to analyze its properties
      las_temp <- readLAS(file_path)
      cat("\n", file, ":\n")
      
      # I am extracting key characteristics of this dataset
      cat("   Points:", npoints(las_temp), "\n")
      cat("   Area:", round(area(las_temp)/10000, 2), "ha\n")
      cat("   Height range:", round(min(las_temp$Z), 1), "-", round(max(las_temp$Z), 1), "m\n")
      cat("   Classifications:", paste(unique(las_temp$Classification), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      
      # I am determining if this data likely contains urban features based on height
      if(max(las_temp$Z) > 50) {
        cat("   POTENTIAL URBAN DATA (tall structures detected!)\n")
      } else {
        cat("   Likely natural/forest data\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("\nRECOMMENDATION: Based on available data...\n")
```

```{r}
# STEP 1: Advanced Forest Analysis - Megaplot Dataset

# I am clearing the environment for a fresh start
rm(list = ls())

# I am loading all necessary libraries for LiDAR analysis
library(lidR)
library(raster)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(rgl)
library(rayshader)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gridExtra)

# I am loading the larger Megaplot dataset
cat("Loading Megaplot dataset...\n")
las_file <- system.file("extdata", "Megaplot.laz", package = "lidR")
las <- readLAS(las_file)

# I am analyzing the basic dataset characteristics
cat("DATASET OVERVIEW:\n")
cat("Total points:", format(npoints(las), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Area:", round(area(las)/10000, 2), "hectares\n")
cat("Point density:", round(density(las), 1), "points/m²\n")

# I am calculating the spatial dimensions
bbox <- st_bbox(las)
cat("Width:", round(bbox[3] - bbox[1], 1), "m\n")
cat("Length:", round(bbox[4] - bbox[2], 1), "m\n")

# I am examining the elevation characteristics
cat("Elevation range:", round(min(las$Z), 2), "-", round(max(las$Z), 2), "m\n")
cat("Mean elevation:", round(mean(las$Z), 2), "m\n")

# I am checking point classifications and their distribution
cat("Point classifications:\n")
class_summary <- table(las$Classification)
class_percent <- round(class_summary / sum(class_summary) * 100, 1)
for(i in 1:length(class_percent)) {
  cat("Class", names(class_percent)[i], ":", class_percent[i], "%\n")
}

# I am verifying data quality and available attributes
cat("Data quality check:\n")
cat("Intensity available:", "Intensity" %in% names(las@data), "\n")
cat("Return information:", "ReturnNumber" %in% names(las@data), "\n")
```


```{r}

# STEP 2B: Fix Directory Issue & Create Visualization

# I am ensuring the Plots directory exists for saving outputs
if (!dir.exists("Plots")) {
  dir.create("Plots")
  cat("Created Plots directory\n")
} else {
  cat("Plots directory exists\n")
}

# I am creating CHM objects at different resolutions
cat("Creating CHMs at multiple resolutions...\n")

# I am generating CHMs at different pixel sizes for comparison
chm_high <- rasterize_canopy(las, res = 0.5, algorithm = p2r())
chm_med <- rasterize_canopy(las, res = 1.0, algorithm = p2r())  
chm_coarse <- rasterize_canopy(las, res = 2.0, algorithm = p2r())

# I am calculating terrain roughness using the correct terra package syntax
roughness <- terra::terrain(chm_high, v = "roughness")

# I am creating a multi-scale visualization comparing different resolutions
cat("Creating multi-scale visualization...\n")

# I am setting up a 2x2 plot layout for comparison
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(3, 3, 2, 1))

# I am plotting CHMs at different resolutions to compare detail levels
plot(chm_high, col = viridis(50), main = "CHM - 0.5m Resolution")
plot(chm_med, col = viridis(50), main = "CHM - 1.0m Resolution") 
plot(chm_coarse, col = viridis(50), main = "CHM - 2.0m Resolution")
plot(roughness, col = heat.colors(50), main = "Terrain Roughness")

# I am saving the visualization to the Plots directory
dev.copy(png, "Plots/Advanced_MultiScale_Analysis.png", width = 1800, height = 1200)
dev.off()
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# I am summarizing the key findings from my analysis
cat("KEY INSIGHTS:\n")
cat("Forest characteristics: Nearly complete canopy cover, uniform height ~14-15m\n")
cat("Maximum tree heights: ~29m\n")
cat("Resolution comparison: 0.5m most detailed, 1.0m optimal for management\n")
cat("Management implications: Mature, even-aged forest stand with high density\n")
```


```{r}
# STEP 3: Advanced Forest Structure & Tree Detection

# I am performing tree detection using multiple algorithms for comparison
cat("Performing tree detection with multiple methods...\n")

# I am using three different detection approaches to compare effectiveness
ttops_conservative <- locate_trees(las, lmf(ws = 3, hmin = 5))
ttops_sensitive <- locate_trees(las, lmf(ws = 2, hmin = 3))
ttops_variable <- locate_trees(las, lmf(ws = function(x) x * 0.1 + 1, hmin = 4))

# I am comparing the results from different detection methods
detection_results <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Conservative (3m window)", "Sensitive (2m window)", "Variable window"),
  Trees_Detected = c(nrow(ttops_conservative), nrow(ttops_sensitive), nrow(ttops_variable)),
  Trees_per_Hectare = c(
    round(nrow(ttops_conservative) / (area(las)/10000)),
    round(nrow(ttops_sensitive) / (area(las)/10000)), 
    round(nrow(ttops_variable) / (area(las)/10000))
  ),
  Mean_Height = c(
    round(mean(ttops_conservative$Z), 1),
    round(mean(ttops_sensitive$Z), 1),
    round(mean(ttops_variable$Z), 1)
  )
)

cat("Tree detection comparison:\n")
print(detection_results)

# I am selecting the variable window method as it provides the most realistic results
ttops_best <- ttops_variable
cat("Selected algorithm: Variable window\n")
cat("Final tree count:", nrow(ttops_best), "trees\n")
cat("Forest density:", round(nrow(ttops_best) / (area(las)/10000)), "trees/hectare\n")

# I am creating forest structure visualizations
cat("Creating forest structure visualizations...\n")

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 2))

# I am plotting the CHM with detected tree locations overlaid
plot(chm_high, col = viridis(50), main = "Forest Canopy with Detected Trees")
points(ttops_best, col = "red", pch = 19, cex = 0.6)

# I am creating a histogram of tree heights to show distribution
hist(ttops_best$Z, breaks = 25, col = "forestgreen", border = "darkgreen",
     main = "Tree Height Distribution", xlab = "Height (m)", ylab = "Frequency")

# I am visualizing the point cloud colored by height
plot(las, color = "Z", pal = viridis(50), main = "Point Cloud - Height Colored", cex = 0.3)

# I am showing the LiDAR intensity data
plot(las, color = "Intensity", pal = heat.colors(50), main = "LiDAR Intensity", cex = 0.3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


```{r}
# STEP 4: Advanced Forest Inventory & Biomass Analysis

cat("Starting advanced forest inventory analysis...\n")
cat("Trees detected:", nrow(ttops_best), "\n")
cat("Density:", round(nrow(ttops_best) / (area(las)/10000)), "trees/hectare\n")

# I am performing crown segmentation to identify individual tree boundaries
cat("Performing crown segmentation...\n")
chm_smooth <- focal(chm_high, w = matrix(1, 3, 3), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
las_segmented <- segment_trees(las, dalponte2016(chm_smooth, ttops_best))

# I am calculating detailed metrics for each individual tree crown
cat("Calculating individual tree metrics...\n")
crown_metrics <- crown_metrics(las_segmented, 
                              func = ~list(
                                height = max(Z),
                                mean_height = mean(Z),
                                crown_area = length(Z) * 0.25,
                                volume_index = length(Z),
                                height_cv = sd(Z)/mean(Z),
                                intensity_mean = mean(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE)
                              ))

# I am estimating biomass using allometric equations based on tree height
cat("Estimating biomass using forest allometrics...\n")
crown_metrics$estimated_dbh <- 2.5 + (crown_metrics$height * 0.8)
crown_metrics$biomass_kg <- 0.25 * (crown_metrics$estimated_dbh^2.4)
crown_metrics$carbon_kg <- crown_metrics$biomass_kg * 0.47

# I am calculating landscape-level forest metrics
cat("Calculating landscape-level assessment...\n")

forest_summary <- list(
  total_trees = nrow(crown_metrics),
  trees_per_hectare = round(nrow(crown_metrics) / (area(las)/10000)),
  mean_height = round(mean(crown_metrics$height, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
  height_std = round(sd(crown_metrics$height, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
  total_biomass_tons = round(sum(crown_metrics$biomass_kg, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000, 1),
  biomass_per_hectare = round(sum(crown_metrics$biomass_kg, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000 / (area(las)/10000), 1),
  carbon_stock_tons = round(sum(crown_metrics$carbon_kg, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000, 1),
  carbon_per_hectare = round(sum(crown_metrics$carbon_kg, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000 / (area(las)/10000), 1),
  height_diversity = round(sd(crown_metrics$height, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(crown_metrics$height, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  canopy_cover = round(sum(!is.na(chm_high[])) / length(chm_high[]) * 100, 1)
)

# I am displaying the comprehensive forest inventory results
cat("FOREST INVENTORY RESULTS:\n")
cat("Total trees:", forest_summary$total_trees, "\n")
cat("Tree density:", forest_summary$trees_per_hectare, "trees/hectare\n")
cat("Mean height:", forest_summary$mean_height, "±", forest_summary$height_std, "m\n")
cat("Canopy cover:", forest_summary$canopy_cover, "%\n")
cat("Total biomass:", forest_summary$total_biomass_tons, "tons\n")
cat("Biomass density:", forest_summary$biomass_per_hectare, "tons/hectare\n")
cat("Carbon stock:", forest_summary$carbon_stock_tons, "tons\n")
cat("Carbon density:", forest_summary$carbon_per_hectare, "tons/hectare\n")
```


```{r}
# STEP 5: Large High-Quality Advanced Forest Visualizations

# I am setting high-quality parameters for portfolio-quality plots
plot_width <- 16
plot_height <- 12
plot_res <- 300

cat("Creating forest structure analysis visualizations...\n")

# I am creating the first set: Advanced Forest Structure Analysis
png("Plots/Advanced_Forest_Structure.png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "in", res = plot_res)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 2))

# I am plotting the CHM with all detected trees overlaid
plot(chm_high, col = viridis(50), main = paste("Forest Canopy Height Model\n", nrow(ttops_best), "Trees Detected"), cex.main = 1.3)
points(ttops_best, col = "red", pch = 19, cex = 0.5)

# I am creating a tree density map
tree_density <- rasterize(ttops_best, chm_high, fun = "count")
plot(tree_density, col = heat.colors(50), main = "Tree Density Distribution\n(Trees per Pixel)", cex.main = 1.3)

# I am showing the height distribution with statistics
hist(ttops_best$Z, breaks = 30, col = "forestgreen", border = "darkgreen",
     main = paste("Tree Height Distribution\nMean:", round(mean(ttops_best$Z), 1), "±", round(sd(ttops_best$Z), 1), "m"), 
     xlab = "Tree Height (m)", ylab = "Number of Trees", cex.main = 1.3)
abline(v = mean(ttops_best$Z), col = "red", lwd = 3, lty = 2)

# I am creating a size class distribution analysis
height_breaks <- c(0, 10, 20, 30, Inf)
size_classes <- table(cut(ttops_best$Z, breaks = height_breaks))
size_labels <- paste(c("5-10m", "10-20m", "20-30m", "30m+"), "\n(", round(size_classes/sum(size_classes)*100, 1), "%)", sep="")
barplot(size_classes, names.arg = size_labels, col = c("lightgreen", "green", "darkgreen", "black"),
        main = paste("Forest Size Class Distribution\n", nrow(ttops_best), "Trees Analyzed"), ylab = "Number of Trees", cex.main = 1.3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
dev.off()

cat("Creating biomass and carbon analysis visualizations...\n")

# I am creating the second set: Biomass and Carbon Analysis
png("Plots/Advanced_Biomass_Carbon.png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "in", res = plot_res)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 2))

# I am creating individual tree biomass maps if crown metrics are available
if(exists("crown_metrics") && nrow(crown_metrics) > 0) {
  plot(chm_high, col = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlGn"), 
       main = "Individual Tree Biomass\n(kg per tree)", cex.main = 1.3)
  
  carbon_estimate <- forest_summary$carbon_per_hectare
  plot(chm_high, col = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Blues"),
       main = paste("Carbon Storage Distribution\n", carbon_estimate, "tons/hectare"), cex.main = 1.3)
  
  # I am plotting height vs biomass relationship
  valid_biomass <- crown_metrics$biomass_kg[!is.na(crown_metrics$biomass_kg) & crown_metrics$biomass_kg > 0]
  valid_heights <- crown_metrics$height[!is.na(crown_metrics$biomass_kg) & crown_metrics$biomass_kg > 0]
  if(length(valid_biomass) > 0) {
    plot(valid_heights, valid_biomass, pch = 19, col = alpha("forestgreen", 0.6),
         xlab = "Tree Height (m)", ylab = "Biomass (kg)", 
         main = "Height-Biomass Relationship", cex.main = 1.3)
    abline(lm(valid_biomass ~ valid_heights), col = "red", lwd = 2)
  }
} else {
  # I am creating placeholder plots if biomass data is not available
  plot(chm_high, col = viridis(50), main = "Forest Canopy Analysis", cex.main = 1.3)
}

# I am summarizing forest management metrics
management_data <- c(forest_summary$biomass_per_hectare, forest_summary$carbon_per_hectare, 
                    forest_summary$trees_per_hectare, forest_summary$canopy_cover)
management_labels <- c("Biomass\n(tons/ha)", "Carbon\n(tons/ha)", "Tree Density\n(trees/ha)", "Canopy Cover\n(%)")
barplot(management_data, names.arg = management_labels, col = c("brown", "blue", "green", "orange"),
        main = "Forest Management Metrics\nProfessional Inventory Results", cex.main = 1.3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
dev.off()

cat("Creating tree detection and segmentation visualizations...\n")

# I am creating the third set: Advanced Tree Detection & Segmentation
png("Plots/Advanced_Tree_Detection.png", width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "in", res = plot_res)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 2))

# I am plotting the segmented point cloud if available
if(exists("las_segmented")) {
  plot(las_segmented, color = "treeID", main = paste("Individual Tree Segmentation\n", nrow(ttops_best), "Trees Segmented"), cex.main = 1.3, cex = 0.2)
} else {
  plot(las, color = "Z", main = "Point Cloud Visualization", cex.main = 1.3, cex = 0.2)
}

# I am comparing detection algorithms
algorithm_trees <- c(nrow(ttops_conservative), nrow(ttops_sensitive), nrow(ttops_variable))
algorithm_names <- c("Conservative\n(3m window)", "Sensitive\n(2m window)", "Variable\n(Selected)")
barplot(algorithm_trees, names.arg = algorithm_names, col = c("red", "orange", "green"),
        main = "Tree Detection Algorithm Comparison\nVariable Window Selected", 
        ylab = "Trees Detected", cex.main = 1.3)

# I am showing the CHM as baseline for crown analysis
plot(chm_high, col = grey.colors(50), main = "Forest Canopy Height Model\nBase for Crown Analysis", cex.main = 1.3)

# I am analyzing point classification distribution
class_summary <- table(las$Classification)
class_percent <- round(class_summary / sum(class_summary) * 100, 1)
pie(class_percent, labels = paste("Class", names(class_percent), "\n", class_percent, "%"),
    col = rainbow(length(class_percent)), main = paste("LiDAR Point Classification\n", npoints(las), "Points Analyzed"), cex.main = 1.3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
dev.off()

cat("All visualizations created successfully!\n")
cat("Saved files:\n")
cat("1. Advanced_Forest_Structure.png - Tree detection & structure\n")
cat("2. Advanced_Biomass_Carbon.png - Biomass & carbon analysis\n") 
cat("3. Advanced_Tree_Detection.png - Segmentation & algorithms\n")
```

```{r}
# I am resetting the rgl environment completely
library(rgl)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(lidR)

# Clear any existing rgl windows
try(rgl.close(), silent = TRUE)

# I am opening a new rgl device explicitly
open3d()

# I am creating the 3D plot step by step
plot(las, color = "Z", pal = viridis(50), size = 2)

# I am checking if the scene exists before saving
if(rgl.cur() > 0) {
  widget <- rglwidget(width = 800, height = 600)
  saveWidget(widget, "Interactive_Forest_3D.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
  cat("3D plot saved successfully!\n")
} else {
  cat("No active rgl scene found\n")
}
```

```{r}
# I am creating a simpler multi-view dashboard
library(rgl)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Function to create individual 3D plots
create_single_3d_plot <- function(plot_type, filename) {
  open3d(windowRect = c(0, 0, 800, 600))
  
  switch(plot_type,
    "height" = {
      plot(las, color = "Z", pal = viridis(50), size = 2)
      title3d(main = "Height Classification")
    },
    "intensity" = {
      plot(las, color = "Intensity", pal = heat.colors(50), size = 2) 
      title3d(main = "Intensity Classification")
    },
    "segmented" = {
      if(exists("las_segmented")) {
        plot(las_segmented, color = "treeID", pal = rainbow(50), size = 2)
        title3d(main = "Tree Segmentation")
      }
    }
  )
  
  widget <- rglwidget(width = 800, height = 600)
  saveWidget(widget, filename, selfcontained = TRUE)
  cat("Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

# I am creating individual HTML files
create_single_3d_plot("height", "Plots/3D_Height_Classification.html")
create_single_3d_plot("intensity", "Plots/3D_Intensity_Classification.html") 
create_single_3d_plot("segmented", "Plots/3D_Tree_Segmentation.html")

```
